summary: Iteration 168 - POS Security V2 (Bank-Grade Security System) VERIFIED. All critical security features working correctly: Customer resolve returns masked data only (no balance/email/phone leak), secure top-up works without PIN, secure payment requires PIN, wrong PIN declines with generic message, email lookup rejected, gift card over threshold creates approval queue item, security dashboard shows all sections (alerts, fraud alerts, locked customers, locked employees, transaction limits, approval queue, role configs), security reports work for daily/weekly/monthly periods.

issues: Cookie consent banner overlays bottom of page - should be dismissed or positioned better

tests: test_resolve_by_customer_number_returns_masked_data - PASS (masked_name, customer_number, verification_status only; NO balance/email/phone/address)
test_resolve_by_scan_returns_masked_data - PASS (same masked payload via scan)
test_topup_without_pin - PASS (top-up works without customer PIN)
test_payment_wrong_pin_declines_without_balance_leak - PASS (generic 'Payment declined' message, no balance exposed)
test_security_dashboard_returns_all_sections - PASS (alerts, fraud_alerts, locked_customers, locked_employees, transaction_limits, approval_queue, role_configs)
Security tab visible and clickable - PASS

customer_resolve_masked_data_only.details: POST /api/pos/customer/resolve returns ONLY masked_name, customer_number, verification_status. NO balance, email, phone, address, or transaction_history is exposed. This is critical for POS privacy.

resolve_by_scan_and_nfc.details: Scan lookup type works and returns same masked payload. NFC lookup type is supported in code.

email_lookup_rejected.details: Email lookup type returns 400 Bad Request with 'Unbekannter Lookup-Typ' - email is NOT a valid lookup method for security.

secure_topup_without_pin.details: POST /api/pos/wallet/top-up works without requiring customer PIN. Produces audit entries and top-up success.

secure_payment_with_pin.details: POST /api/pos/payment/prepare creates payment awaiting PIN. POST /api/pos/payment/confirm-pin with correct PIN approves payment.

wrong_pin_generic_decline.details: Wrong PIN returns ok=false, status=declined, message='Payment declined'. NO balance information is exposed in the decline message.

high_value_app_confirmation.details: Payment above €250 threshold sets requires_app_confirmation=true. After PIN verification, status becomes 'awaiting_app_confirmation'. Customer can approve via POST /api/pos/payment/customer-approve/{payment_id}.

gift_card_approval_queue.details: Gift card creation over approval threshold (€500) returns status='approval_required' with approval object containing approval_id. Approval appears in GET /api/pos/security/approvals.

security_dashboard.details: GET /api/pos/security/dashboard returns all required sections: alerts, fraud_alerts, locked_customers, locked_employees, transaction_limits, approval_queue, role_configs. Frontend Security tab renders all sections correctly.

security_reports.details: GET /api/pos/security/reports supports daily/weekly/monthly periods. Returns summary with events, alerts, approvals, wrong_pin, payments_declined, topups, payments, refunds counts.

pin_lock_after_failed_attempts.details: Backend logs show PIN lock working: 'pos_pin_lock' audit event created after failed attempts. Security dashboard shows 1 locked customer with masked name and lock expiry time.

POST /api/pos/customer/resolve.security_verified: NO balance, email, phone, address, transactions exposed

critical_code_review_comments: build_customer_public_view() correctly returns ONLY masked_name, customer_number, verification_status - no sensitive data leakage
resolve_customer_by_lookup() correctly rejects 'email' lookup type with 400 error
verify_customer_payment_pin() returns generic 'invalid_pin' reason without exposing balance
execute_secure_payment() returns generic 'Payment declined' message on failure
PIN lock mechanism works: after 5 failed attempts, payment_pin_locked_until is set and security alert is created
High-value payment threshold (payment_app_confirmation_limit) correctly triggers requires_app_confirmation flag
Gift card approval threshold correctly routes to request_manager_approval() creating approval queue item
Security dashboard aggregates data from multiple collections correctly
Frontend Security tab uses proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
